تجصوا (form I)
# تَجُصُّوا (tajuṣṣū) /ta.d͡ʒusˤ.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of جَصَّ (jaṣṣa)
# تُجَصُّوا (tujaṣṣū) /tu.d͡ʒasˤ.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of جَصَّ (jaṣṣa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
